artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer exhaustive verification of the fixed-exponent classifications and direct divisor-subset cross-checks.
Deterministic output of the exhaustive finite verification for \(a=1,2,3,4\) and supplementary automatic-region checks.

limitations: A differently notated specialization of the general divisor-partition criterion may exist in unindexed recreational-number-theory literature.; For general \(a\), the result is an effective criterion rather than a closed-form classification.
record_title: An effective criterion for Zumkeller numbers of the form 2^a p q
scientific_context: For \(n=2^a p q\) with odd primes \(p<q\), the Zumkeller condition is automatic below a natural prime threshold; beyond it, the theorem gives an exact bounded coefficient criterion and finite reduction.
